errors.evidence: The Cardio fine-tuned model bar is described as 'light yellow', but the figure and atom checklist specify it as 'light orange'.
The Gastro fine-tuned model bar is described as 'light peach/tan', but the figure and atom checklist specify it as 'orange'.

The description states there are seven bars per group, but the figure shows six bars (one base model and five fine-tuned models, not six). The atom checklist confirms six specialties plus the base model.
The description states the Cardio and Gastro fine-tuned bars reach around -26 to -26.2, but the figure shows values closer to -25.5 to -26, not as extreme as -26.2.
The description does not explicitly state that all bars start from -22 downwards towards -27, as specified in the atom checklist.

errors.text_span: followed by six bars representing models fine-tuned on Cardio (light yellow), Gastro (light peach/tan), Infect (medium orange), Neuro (darker orange), Obstetrics (dark brown-orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states there are six fine-tuned models, but the figure and atom checklist show five fine-tuned models (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics) plus the base model, totaling six bars, not seven. The color descriptions for Cardio and Gastro are also incorrect.

errors.text_span: for example, in the Cardio group, the fine-tuned bars extend downward to values ranging from roughly -22.5 to approximately -26.2, with the Cardio fine-tuned model (light yellow) and Gastro fine-tuned model reaching around -26 to -26.2, representing the most negative values in that group. In the Infect group, the fine-tuned bars cluster more closely together, mostly ranging between approximately -22.2 and -24.5. In the Neuro group, values span from about -22.3 to -25. The Obstetrics and Pediatrics groups show fine-tuned bars ranging roughly from -23 to -25
